Keep every ⚠.

# As above, So below II (V2)

> **⚠⚠ V1 SOURCE IS NOT GONE: `D:\Rimworld\As above, So below\<yyyymmdd-hhmmss>\Source\`** (ten snapshots, newest `20260726-154207`). READ THE V1 FILE FIRST when a V2 feature has an ancestor. `read` refuses that path; `bash`/`grep`/`sed` reach it.

# 0. START HERE — WINDOW 18

**WINDOW 17 IN ONE PARAGRAPH (closed 2026-08-31).** §95 render-level support for visual-FX mods: Tiers A+B and E→E2 FIELD-VERIFIED; §96 water diagnosed to square `_MapSize` over two lab runs; §97 split into §87.b (fixed, VERIFIED) and a TO half not reproduced (parked). At close, run #497 surfaced §95.j (static-fleck seam silently failed on `FleckSystemStatic`) and the ABWaterLab attribute gap — both fixed, **both STILL UNTESTED**.

**WINDOW 18.** User-directed audit + optimization pass (§98), then GL + Map Preview compat. Headline: **the entire Map Preview bridge had been dead for an unknown number of versions** — `Resolve()` threw on its second statement and skipped the step that installs everything. Repaired; the whole landform chain (§56q/§56n/§56m/§56r) is **FIELD-VERIFIED at #508** both numerically and by user screenshots. §96's water fix was then implemented and shipped, but **its A/B did not discriminate** — see §96 for exactly what that does and does not license.

**⚠⚠ WINDOW 18 NEXT MOVES, IN ORDER:**
1. **THE PUBLISH PASS** (checklist §31) — now carries §94 docs debt + §95 + §87.b + §96 + §98. UPDATE_NOTES rewrite; commit AND PUSH (nothing since `f2939e1`); decompile-prove Release; About/Preview = user's copy; glyph ruling; **subscribe-to-own-item ask**. ⚠ NOTES WORDING: §98's "map previews now match the colony you generate" is safe and is the most user-visible fix in the release. **Do NOT claim the water fix as a water fix** — see §96.e; say nothing, or say "water rendering on stacked maps" without a mechanism.
2. **⚠ §95.j static flecks + ABWaterLab — STILL UNTESTED** (w17 carry-over; no w18 run covered them). Cheap: pin horseshoes on the surface, watch from a sky band, expect mirrored horseshoes; grep "fleck mirror seated on N", NO "could not seat".
3. **⚠ INSTRUMENTATION POLICY DECISION (ask the user):** w18's root cause hid for versions behind `ABLog.Dev`, which is `verboseLogging`-gated and OFF by default (rule 64 exactly). Proposal: promote the ONE-LINE compat resolve summary per bridge to an always-on `Log.Message`. Not done — rule 5.
4. **§97 TO report** — parked on reporter questionnaire.
5. **⚠ THE CARVE IS THE REAL GENERATION BILL** — see ledger 8; the next perf prize and it is a big one.
6. Standing queue: E3 (§95.i), §88 CE (queued four windows), §89 (instrumentation ruling FIRST — asked w15+w16, unanswered).

**✅ SHIPPED/LIVE:** w12-15 on Workshop 3776015553 (w15 `f2939e1`); §94 published user-solo. **⚠ LOCAL GIT: nothing pushed since `f2939e1`; w17 AND w18 work is in autosaves only.** THE WORKSPACE DLL IS A DEBUG BUILD — NORMAL (`#if DEBUG` is the off switch; DECOMPILE TO PROVE at publish, rule 17/64).

**⚠ USER WORKING RULES:** (1) NEVER source design ideas from other mods unless asked — scans COMPAT ONLY; V1 exempt. (2) Building art = USER. (3) About description = USER's copy. (4) N mockups = N choices. (5) NO NEW INSTRUMENTATION WITHOUT ASKING. (6) A user deferral is a ruling. **(7) THE USER MAY CLOSE AN INVESTIGATION ON "IT WORKS" — record the residual uncertainty in the spec and move on; do not re-litigate it.**

**⚠ SHIPPED KNOWINGLY UNVERIFIED (standing):** §91.c DORMANT; §90 elevator-fallback + walled-front-tile; §85 flipped up-link approachCells; §62.N, §70; §62.M, §66c, §66e. **⚠ VERIFIED-WITH-CAVEAT:** §94.g FLIP (never log-captured); **§96 square `_MapSize` (works, mechanism UNATTRIBUTED — §96.e)**. **⚠ BUILT-UNTESTED:** §95.j seam fix + ABWaterLab attribute (w17); §56p biome-transition suppression (resolved FOUND, never visually verified); §98's C-items (in, exercised incidentally, no defects seen). **✅ FIELD-VERIFIED W18 (#508):** §56q, §56n, §56m, §56r, the MapPreviewCompat resolver repair.

**What this mod is.** Up to seven z-levels in ONE RimWorld `Map`, banded along +z. Priorities: visual clarity from above, performance, vanilla parity.

**⚠⚠ THE RULES (headline forms; unabridged pre-w17 revs):** 1 CLAMP AT SELECTION. 2 NEVER PATCH `TryRebuildDirtyRegionsAndRooms`. 3 FLOOD CELLS. 4 COUNT EMITTERS/POPULATIONS/STACKS. 5 A `Touch` TARGET IS USUALLY UNWALKABLE. 6 A VANILLA HELPER CAN BE A NO-OP. 7 THE CARVE IS NOT THE LAST WORD. 8 A REPAIR PASS MUST NOT RE-CREATE DELIBERATE REMOVALS. 9 SOME MISPLACEMENTS ARE NOT VISIBLE IN THE CELL. 10 A STRUCTURE IS NOT A CELL. 11 A CELL VERDICT CANNOT AUTHORIZE A PAWN ACTION. 12 A FOREIGN SNAPSHOT IS AN INPUT YOU CAN CORRECT (**§56r is its purest form: we corrected the INPUTS GL reads, not GL**). 13 NEVER COPY A GRID YOU DID NOT WATCH BEING WRITTEN. 14 ASK WHAT IS AT THE DESTINATION. 15 ASSERT ALWAYS, NARRATE ON REQUEST (**§56r's `AssertNoneOutstanding`**). 16 COUNT THE WRITE PATHS. 17 A PASSING RUN THAT DID NOT REPRODUCE THE FAILURE IS NOT A FIX + decompile the binary (**w18 lived it four times: the `MaxStackedZ` "bug" evaporated on arithmetic; the field rename was only provable against the installed dll; screenshots from a still-running session nearly passed as a fix — CHECK LOG mtime AGAINST BUILD mtime; and §96's A/B never reproduced the failure at all**). 18 NEVER EXONERATE ON ONE CLEAN SAMPLE. 19 `TicksGame` RESTARTS. 20 EARLIER WORK TURNS ON EVERY READINESS GATE. 21 THE PARALLEL GRIDS DO NOT TRAVEL. 22 A DERIVED GRID HAS NO PAWN. 23 AUDIT THE WEIGHTING. 24 CLAMP THE TARGET TOO. 25 A POSTFIX ON `Update` IS TOO LATE. 26 PASS THE RENDERER'S GATE. 27 SPAWN/DESPAWN OVER FLICK. 28 A FICTION FOR ONE SUBSYSTEM IS FACT TO THE REST. 29 REPORT OUTCOMES. 30 A FELT DURATION IS A CHAIN. 31 MAKE THE GUARD SAY WHICH CLAUSE. 32 A TICK CARRIES SERVICES. 33 A FILTER THAT CAN REJECT EVERYTHING MUST SAY SO + COUNT PER-CLASS FAILURES. 34 INVISIBLE = ABSENT FROM EVERY LAYER. 35 A CLONED DEF IS IN NO LOOKUPS. 36 RUN VANILLA'S PREDICATE. 37 NAME THE ENFORCEMENT POINT — LAB OVER THEORY. 38 OWN THE DRAW — AT THE FUNNEL. 39 LAST WRITE ≠ SETTLED TARGET. 40 A TRIPWIRE BEFORE THE OBSERVER IS NOT A TRIPWIRE. 41 AN UNSET FIELD IS AN UNSHIPPED FEATURE. 42 READ-DIRECTION IS THE THING'S PROPERTY. 43 DEFER THE MOVE, NEVER THE DECISION. 44 A WHOLE OFFSET ON FRAME ONE IS A TELEPORT. 45 TRAVEL ≠ ELEVATION. 46 SCALE × ROTATION = SHEAR. 47 A CACHED CURSOR CELL IS A COORDINATE ASSUMPTION. 48 A WRITE READ BACK BY ITS CALLER IS NOT A WRITE. 49 A TEST FOR A SAYS NOTHING ABOUT B. 50 TWO OWN PATCHES CANCEL SILENTLY. 51 A FACTORY CONSUMED ITS INPUT. 52 AN OVERLAY ASKS THE CLICK'S QUESTION, READ-ONLY. 53 A PREDICATE IS CLOSED OVER ITS CALLER'S ARGS. 54 SEARCH THE CAPABILITY. 55 FALLBACK JOBS COUNT. 56 RANK-VS-FILTER FINDS THE BLIND SPOT. 57 TWO "WHICH SIDE" ANSWERS = ONE WRONG. 58 ART ≠ DEF. 59 MEASURE size FROM THE DRAWING. 60 MEASURE THE PIXELS. 61 A COLOURED GRAPHIC IS A DIFFERENT OBJECT. 62 FINISHED-ANSWER TABLES ROT — **and so do FOREIGN FIELD NAMES (`MapSizeOverride` → `GameInitMapSizeOverride`)**. 63 MEASURE PATIENCE FROM ITS EVENT. 64 OFF-BY-DEFAULT DIAGNOSTICS DON'T EXIST — **w18's headline scar: a dead bridge hid for versions behind one `verboseLogging` line**. 65 THE FOURTH FAILURE IS A DEFECTIVE INPUT. 66 A DESTINATION DOESN'T CONSTRAIN ENTRY SIDE. 67 ASK WHO SENT THE NEW ORDER. 68 TWICE ON ONE DEF = THE DEF'S RULE. 69 SUSPENDING A DRIVER INHERITS ITS REQUESTS. 70 OPT-IN AT N CONSUMERS = WRONG LAYER. 71 "THE" OCCUPANT CANNOT SEE A STACK. 72 A NAMED-BUILDING DESTINATION OUTLIVES CORRECTIONS. 73 A PROBE COMPUTING ITS OWN ANSWER ISN'T READING. 74 NAME THE DENOMINATOR. 75 CROSS-BAND LENGTH PRICES NORTH AS UP. 76 VERIFY THE WINNER.
**⚠ 77 (w18) A REVERTED FIX MAY HAVE BEEN CORRECT ARITHMETIC ON A POISONED INPUT.** Find the PRECONDITION that made it wrong and ask whether it still holds. §56m's mask was reverted because GL painted the destination; §56n stopped the painting, so the mask became right. They are ONE change.
**⚠ 78 (w18) ONE `try` AROUND N LOOKUPS MAKES N FEATURES ONE FEATURE.** A compat resolver that catches once aborts at the FIRST dead member and silently skips every install after it. Isolate each lookup; put the step that installs the integration LAST and unconditional.
**⚠ 79 (w18) A HOST THAT SKIPS GENSTEPS GIVES ITS GUESTS DIFFERENT FACTS.** Map Preview runs 6 gensteps, so `RocksFromGrid` never runs and its anchor rows are edifice-free. Any generation-time patch whose output depends on map state must ask whether that state exists in the preview too.
**⚠ 80 (w18) A FIX THAT CANNOT BE SWITCHED OFF AGAIN IS A FIX YOU CANNOT ATTRIBUTE.** §96 shipped with a working A/B toggle and STILL could not be attributed, because the symptom was never reproduced in the OFF state on the tile being tested. Before believing any render fix: reproduce the FAILURE first, on the water/tile that showed it, THEN turn the fix on.

# 96. WATER RENDER PARITY — **SHIPPED w18; ⚠⚠ WORKS, BUT THE MECHANISM IS UNATTRIBUTED**

**96.a PIPELINE:** `WaterInfo.SetTextures` runs per frame from `Map.MapUpdate` and publishes `_WaterOutputTex` (WaterDepth subcamera RT), `_WaterReflectionTex`, camera params, `_WaterOffsetTex` (riverFlowTexture, FULL map size, `Clamp` wrap, pixels only where `BaseTerrainAt.IsRiver`) and, as its LAST statement, `_MapSize` = (x, z). Compiled shader unreadable.
**96.b THE SHIPPED FIX (`ABWaterMapSize.cs`, `Patch_WaterInfo_ABBandSquareMapSize`):** on banded maps only, republish `_MapSize` as (x, bandHeight) — the level's own dimensions rather than the stack's. Reads real `bandHeight` (square by §2, but not assumed). Stands down while the lab drives, so the A/B rig cannot lie. Dev toggle: `AB2: water - toggle SHIPPED band _MapSize fix`.
**96.c DELIVERY — SETTLED BY MEASUREMENT (#509):** `0 of 6 water depth material(s) declare _MapSize`. **Material-local shadowing was NEVER possible**; a material-local write would have compiled, run every frame and silently done nothing. Global is the only delivery that can work — and it is inherently water-scoped, because `_MapSize` is written in EXACTLY ONE place in all of vanilla (`WaterInfo.SetTextures:87`), verified by source search. This also retroactively settles w17's unrecorded round-2 detail: it was the GLOBAL toggle that worked.
**96.d MECHANISM (plausible, not proven):** the shader UVs its surface by `worldPos.xz / _MapSize`, so (126, 896) divides z seven times harder than x and stretches ripples into vertical streaks — which also explains the symptom's uniformity, since a coordinate scale hits lakes and ocean alike.
**96.e ⚠⚠ WHAT #509 DID AND DID NOT ESTABLISH.** With the fix ON the water looked correct. **With the fix toggled OFF the streaking did NOT return** — so the A/B did not discriminate and the fix is NOT attributed. Three live possibilities, unresolved: (A) `_MapSize` is not the cause and round 2 was itself confounded, in which case something else in w18 fixed the water — most likely §56n/§56r changing GL's water authoring, or `ABWaterBand.ToSurfaceBand`; (B) the toggle did not take (untested — `report+` prints `published _MapSize` and would have shown it in seconds); (C) the tile (`GL_CliffAndCoast` ocean) never reproduced the symptom, which was originally reported on a LAKE. **USER CLOSED THE INVESTIGATION ON "it works fine" (rule 7) — do not re-litigate uninvited.** Shipping is low-risk regardless: banded-only, single-publisher global, no collateral in three runs. **⚠ THE 30-SECOND PROTOCOL, for whenever a lake is in front of us:** `paint test pond` → `report+` (expect `_MapSize (126,126)`) → toggle the shipped fix OFF → `report+` (expect `(126,896)`) → look again. Rule 80. **⚠ RELEASE NOTES: do not claim this as a water fix with a mechanism.**

# 98. W18 AUDIT + GL / MAP PREVIEW REPAIR — **FIELD-VERIFIED #508**

**98.a THE AUDIT (four mechanical passes; harness in `%TEMP%/abscan/`).** 135 files / 50,336 lines / 357 types / 1,236 methods / 115 attributed + 18 manual patches. **12 dead methods** (verified twice); **28 clone pairs, largest 10 logic lines**; **16 cache-hostile x-outer/z-inner loops**; **54 silent catches of 303**; **5 targets patched by 2+ of our own classes**. CLEAN: zero TODO/FIXME/HACK, no leaking statics, both hottest patches already optimal. ⚠ Pass-3 call-graph reachability OVER-REPORTS — `ABCameraBounds.Summary` is button-triggered and its dialog is dev-only; always confirm the caller before optimising.
**98.b THE ROOT CAUSE THAT DWARFED THE REST.** `AccessTools.Method(sizeUtilType, "DetermineMapSize")` throws AmbiguousMatchException on the shipped 1.6 assembly (both overloads survive despite the `#if` in source). It was the SECOND statement inside `Resolve()`'s single try, so the whole method aborted: MaxMapSize never raised, no size hook installed, crop/window/reroll patches unarmed. **The Map Preview bridge had been 100% dead for an unknown number of versions**, reporting it through one `verboseLogging`-gated line. Fixes: `FindDetermineMapSize()` selects by SHAPE (returns IntVec2, last param MapParent, longest wins, never throws) and `Resolve()` is per-step isolated with `RaiseSizeCaps` LAST and unconditional (rule 78).
**98.c THE LANDFORM CHAIN — FOUR PARTS, ALL REQUIRED.** Order: `ElevationFertility(10) → MutatorPostElevationFertility(20) → RocksFromGrid(200) → Terrain(210) → MutatorPostTerrain(220)`. **§56q SIZE** — register a `MapSizeTransform` (their supported 1.6 hook, composes with VEF's); the postfix is a disarmed fallback. **§56n POLLUTION** — clamp `ApplyBuffered`'s `mapSize.z` to the anchor height on BOTH closed generics (both or neither, else disable + warn); stops GL painting the surface band and removes ~4x wasted evaluation. **§56m IMPORT** — per-cell write mask restores the authored-cell lift, legal ONLY because §56n removed the pollution (rule 77). **§56r DECISION CONTEXT** (`ABGLContextBorrow`, own file) — GL's `TerrainAt` reads four map-space inputs at the ANCHOR rows, so coastlines stopped wherever BASEMENT rock was (measured #507: anchor 6,092 edifices vs surface 4,929; GL authored 1,893 where a preview authored 3,619). The borrow lends the surface band's four inputs to the anchor rows for GL's method body only; released at the TOP of the postfix before the lift; only anchor rows written; half-taken unwinds; `AssertNoneOutstanding` shouts on a leak.
**98.d VERIFICATION (#508, `GL_CoastCorner`, 126×896).** `context=SURFACE(15876 cells borrowed)` on every pass; authored cells 1,893 → **7,159**; no failure, no leak, no warning. ⚠ THE RESTORE IS SELF-VERIFYING: the post-pass census shows anchor edifice=2,526 vs surface=3,059 — equal would mean a leak. User screenshots confirm coastline, rock masses and peninsula all line up. ⚠ **"anchor water == surface water" is NOT the correctness criterion** — I over-read it once. With authored-cell lifting the slices SHOULD differ slightly wherever GL declined and the two rows' vanilla terrain disagrees (#509: 1-2% residuals, real colony exact). The criterion is the visible landform. ⚠ Previews author MORE than the colony and that is CORRECT (rule 79): previews have no rock, and declined cells sit under stone the preview paints anyway (`RocksFromGrid` at Elevation > 0.7; MapPreview paints stone at >= 0.7 — they agree by construction).
**98.e DELIBERATELY NOT CHANGED (do not "fix" these).** **C4 `CompMemo`** — readonly fields are the lock-free publish contract (§91); mutable statics would open a torn read on the preview thread, and it allocates once per MAP SWITCH. **riverFlowMap lift loop** — GL indexes `(x * Size.z + z) * 2`, X-MAJOR, already sequential. **`SectionLayer_ABBelowSnow` L110** — order must match `MakeBaseGeometry`'s nine-vertices-per-cell contract. **Snow L267** — already sequential. **Shadows L156 / V2Water L260** — 289-cell and 17×17 walks on mesh rebuild. **11 remaining dead methods** — pending a keep/delete ruling; two documented as deliberately kept.
**98.f WHAT ELSE SHIPPED.** §56p `Patch_GL_ABBiomeTransitionScope` (suppresses `PostProcessBiomeGrid`'s cross-seam flood fill on banded maps; resolved FOUND, not visually verified). `ABBandedGeneration.RealGenerationInFlight` — new gate distinguishing "the real colony" from "what is this map's layout"; `ABGenProfile` now uses it, because `TryPendingSurfaceRect` answers TRUE for previews BY DESIGN and the profiler was arming on Map Preview's background thread. 9 GL transplant loops reordered z-outer/x-inner. `PlaceWorker_ABLinkApproach.DrawGhost` list reuse. `ABMapSizeLimit.ChooserStrings` memo (12 `Translate()` + 4 `N0` per frame → rebuilt on change only, keyed on `LanguageDatabase.activeLanguage`).
**98.g TEMPORARY DIAGNOSTICS STILL IN THE BUILD** (all `ABLog.Dev`, off for players): `Map Preview transform CALLED`, `FALLBACK postfix fired`, `inferred layout ACCEPTED/DECLINED` (one-shot per map), `DetermineMapSize -> N-arg overload`, `context=SURFACE(N cells borrowed)`, `band water _MapSize -> square publish active`. Keep or prune at publish — they are cheap and are exactly what would have caught 98.b years earlier.
**98.h KNOWN REMAINING GAP.** The context borrow covers the TERRAIN pass only. The ELEVATION pass gates its caves module on `elevation[c] > 0.7f`, read at anchor rows; for a landform that authors elevation (Lone Mountain, Cirque) that gate reads basement values. Not observed — `GL_Coast`/`GL_CoastCorner`/`GL_CliffAndCoast` author NO elevation in every w18 run. ⚠ Snapshot ordering is the trap if implemented: the anchor snapshot must be taken AFTER borrowing, or the borrow itself reads as "GL authored".
